content.heading: PIL under Article 32
content.text: A bona fide public-interest petitioner may invoke Article 32 of the Constitution to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of fundamental rights conferred by Part III on behalf of persons unable to approach the Court. PIL under Article 32 remains confined to fundamental-rights enforcement; liberalised standing does not convert Article 32 into a general public-interest jurisdiction beyond Part III. The Court may issue appropriate writs, orders, or directions. Private disputes dressed as PIL are not maintainable.
